scenes.headline: How a memory model decides what to keep
scenes.sub: One conversation turn, traced through the Hy Memory engine
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Plinth! Let's follow one turn through Tencent's Hy Memory, and a model trained only to write memories.

scenes.text: A memory writer is a policy acting on external state: what it stores, merges or supersedes decides what any later answer can use.
scenes.mark: decides what any later answer can use
scenes.say: A reader cannot recover a fact that was never stored. The writer decides what later answers can use.

steps.say: A new turn arrives. The first model call extracts durable facts and drops the small talk.
Each fact is searched against stored facts. Only matches above a fused score of zero point four go forward.
The second call reconciles them: add, merge, or supersede a fact that is no longer true.
The bank applies the operations. Recall needs no model, just an embedding and a search.

items.say: Update, to merge a detail into the same fact.
Supersede, when both cannot be true. The old fact stays as history.

steps.say: In the engine's own diagram, the write row is embed, extraction, then reconcile.
The search row is recall, fusion, and a response in three channels.

scenes.label: read by one extraction call, for 106 written
scenes.say: One extraction call read about two and a half thousand tokens to write about a hundred.

scenes.title: How the writer was trained
scenes.text: score = probes + 2 x outcome - 0.3 x growth
scenes.say: Training scores each chunk of writes by what the bank can answer.

parts.note: did this chunk's facts survive, and did traps stay out
parts.say: Probes check that facts survived, and traps check that filler stayed out.

parts.note: later questions, credited back to this chunk
parts.say: Outcome credit comes from later questions, traced back to this chunk.

parts.note: penalty when the bank grows too fast
parts.say: A growth penalty stops it storing everything.

scenes.title: Lead over Claude Opus 5, by framework
scenes.say: It leads Claude Opus 5 everywhere, but two margins are hundredths of a point. Without travel planning, Opus leads.

scenes.text: The writer can only reconcile what retrieval hands it.
scenes.say: The writer can only reconcile what retrieval hands it. A contradiction the search misses stays.

recap: Rewards ask what the bank can answer
A tie with Opus 5, not a rout
scenes.say: Extract, search, reconcile, store. And read the tie as a tie.
